summary: Phase 25 ARISE deepening — full backend + frontend verification. 18/18 new Phase-25 tests PASS. 89/89 regression tests (Phase 21-24) PASS. Cumulative 107/107 green. Frontend /arise-console renders for principal with all 5 tabs functional: Scorer (AUC=1.000 holdout >= 0.78 threshold, 41 features, strong CSE@rank2500 prob 96.0% > weak CIVIL@rank200000 prob 0.9%), Enrollment Predictor (prob 68.9%, n=192), EAPCET (best-match + 7-branch list with cutoffs), Source Mix (192 leads, best=Education fair, sorted desc), B-Category (allocation succeeded). Role gating verified: student does NOT see sidebar-nav-arise-console; direct /arise-console nav renders page (consistent with prior console pattern); write APIs return 403 to student (backend test). Cross-tenant 403 verified (backend test). Auto-drip and NEXUS handoff (idempotent) verified via backend tests.

issues: React hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' — caused by the Emergent dev annotation tooling (data-ve-dynamic) injecting <span> wrappers inside native <option> children. Pre-existing pattern from veImpl, does not affect functionality (selects render and submit correctly). Non-blocking; main agent may consider mapping lead label to a flat string to silence the warning in production.

critical_code_review_comments: AriseConsole.jsx (382 LOC) is well-organised into 5 tab sub-components, no immediate refactor needed.

PredictTab/EapcetTab fit a small LR on every API call — acceptable for current dataset sizes (as documented by main agent); consider memoising/caching once leads cross ~10K to keep p95 latency in check.

B-Category allocation only checks soft caps server-side — UI does not currently surface the remaining capacity per (quota, branch); adding a tiny KPI under bcat-form-panel would close the operator-feedback gap.

Source attribution UI does not render a no-data empty state when total_leads = 0 (would just render nothing). Low risk because the endpoint will normally have data, but adding an empty state is recommended.

Lead select <option> children contain JSX expression spans (l.name · l.preferred_branch · l.stage) — the dev-tools annotation wraps in <span> causing a React hydration warning. Replacing with a single template literal would silence it.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 25 ARISE deepening fully green (107/107 cumulative). The /arise-console route is intentionally NOT route-protected — role-gating is enforced via (a) sidebar visibility and (b) backend write-API 403s. The 'login URL pattern' caveat: app navigates to '/' post-login (NOT /dashboard); use wait_for_selector on [data-testid^=sidebar-nav-] instead of wait_for_url('/dashboard'). The Phase-25 fixture seeds ~75 leads per full run — they persist in admissions_leads but the source/scorer/eapcet endpoints normalise on aggregates and remain stable. The single hydration warning around <option><span> is a dev-tooling annotation artifact, not a real bug.
rca of the issue: No bugs found. Initial Playwright wait_for_url('**/dashboard**') was a test-script issue (app routes to '/'); fixed in retry by waiting on sidebar selector instead. All tested flows working as specified.
